claims.evidence: Witness could not read any brand/model marking; identity logged as generic 'by_type' with brand null.

claims.claim: Suitable for homes, security personnel, etc.
claims.evidence: Marketing description, not a verifiable physical fact from the photo.

No receipt or warranty card visible in the photo.

risks.risk: Light may not power on or hold charge
risks.proof: Short clip showing the torch switched on (all brightness modes) and charging port/cable connected with indicator light
Photo or clip of battery indicator or charge-time demonstration
Photo laying out all included accessories next to the unit
Close-up photo of any nameplate, sticker, or molded logo on the body or battery compartment

risks.risk: Claimed receipt/warranty may not exist or match item
risks.proof: Photo of the actual receipt and warranty card with matching date/serial

risks.risk: Hidden wear or prior repair not visible in a single angle
risks.proof: Additional photos from multiple angles including underside and battery compartment seams
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetically unverified beyond shown angle

proof_requests: Video of the torch switched on at all brightness settings
Video/photo of the unit charging with indicator light visible
Photo of any brand/model label or sticker on the body or battery compartment
Photo showing all included accessories (charger, cable, box) together with the unit
Photo of the original receipt and warranty card
Additional photos from multiple angles (rear, underside, battery compartment open)
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a generic rechargeable LED spotlight/searchlight, so it can be priced at worst case (unbranded, unproven function, no accessories) pending the listed proofs.
